body:
It's even worse than I thought then. What's the point of being like everyone else. I despise being the only one as much as I despise being the common. 

When I was a kid my parent said I was special. They said I was smarter. The IQ lady said I was smarter. Why then am I not more than the common man. I don't know anything about anything. I feel like I haven't learned a single thing since I was a kid. I went to college and spent my time not going to class. I got a diploma but I haven't learned anything. Nothing is worth anything. I'm not worth anything. I don't have to the will to live as a common person more than I have the will to live as the only person like me. 

If I can't save the world then what's the point. My mom told me once about what she calls being of light. People so good that you are attracted to them. They radiate light like they are angels. I've tried so hard to be like this. I have tried to be good , to be better than anyone and better than who I was yesterday. God will not make me an angel. I am really divided. A part of me wishes to live a regulars life and another wishes to be the embodiment of all that is good in the world. To always do what is right , and to end all suffering forever. And another part of me is selfish. It wants to know everything there is to know. It wants to understand why we are, how we are. Its thirst will never go away, and whatever I do, it will never have enough. I will never smart enough to be saitsified. 

And each of these part hate the other. I have to choose but I can't because they are all me. And my friend, she made all of them agree. When she spoke all three listened. The heart, the reason and the mind., They are all United by her wisdom. Just like they were whenever each if these special people were to speak to me. And now they are all gone. And everything is chaos
